steps.expectedBehavior: The Gate starts from a fixed, independently derived denominator and a truthful baseline.
steps.functionalProof: The derivation reports exactly 105 canonical plus 58 lesson requirements.

steps.expectedBehavior: Valid profiles deterministically produce closed plans and only complete evidence-backed results can derive PASS.
steps.functionalProof: Thirty-five evaluator tests demonstrate strict contracts and policy loading, deterministic plans, a structured sandbox-only execution boundary, complete evidence requirements, finding recurrence, and fail-closed verdict mutations; eleven control tests prove the closed Gate and compose registration.

steps.expectedBehavior: All supported stacks execute only inside content-addressed sandbox images.
steps.functionalProof: The real container engine ran all three content-addressed quality images through shell-only, network-none policies and verified pinned Python, Node/npm, JDK/Maven/Gradle toolchains, secret scanning, diff integrity and failed internet sockets; the complete sandbox suite passed 148 tests.

steps.expectedBehavior: Evidence and lifecycle facts are immutable, durable, origin-checked, resolvable, and reproducible.
Quality runs survive restarts, cancel and time out safely, and are exposed through stable bounded interfaces.
Functional acceptance, resumable program state, and review bundles are permanent validated controls.
Real PASS, FAIL, IACode, reproduction, and adversarial scenarios distinguish truthfully without host effects.
All mandatory gates and evidence are complete and the implementing run stops at READY_FOR_REVIEW.
